ordered_actions.description: trajectory-analyzer initiated forensic audit across Chapter 4 deliverables and script compilers.

Inspected 02_analysis_code/compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py (lines 798-827, 843-850, 893-900, 929-935), identifying that Table 15 (Correlation Matrix) flattens row numbers and variable names into a single column ('متغیرها'), and Tables 16 and 19 embed row numbers directly into variable labels.

Inspected 03_deliverables/Chapter_4_Results.md (lines 178, 208, 221, 346, 383, 485), revealing that Table 4-13 merges variable and subscale into 'متغیر/سازه', Table 4-15 lacks a separate 'مؤلفه' column, and Tables 4-20 and 4-23 concatenate row numbers in 'متغیرها'.

Inspected 03_deliverables/Chapter_4_Tables_Only.md (lines 138-154, 156-172, 187-202), discovering that Table 4-13 uses em-dashes ('— اضطراب آینده‌نگر') in Column 2, Table 4-14 merges 'مقیاس / خرده‌مقیاس', and Table 4-16 already prototyped the 3-column architecture ('ردیف', 'متغیر', 'مؤلفه') but was not synchronized into the DOCX compiler.

Defined the canonical 3-column architecture across all affected tables: Column 1 ('ردیف'), Column 2 ('متغیر'), and Column 3 ('مؤلفه'), completely eliminating embedded row numbers and merged variable/subscale cells.
Audited all 32 tables in Chapter 4, identifying 4 primary tables requiring structural 3-column transformation and 3 secondary candidate tables, producing full row-by-row cell mappings.
Saved structured trajectory reconstruction JSON conforming to .agents/contracts/evolution/trajectory.schema.json and companion Markdown report.

important_decisions.selected_option: Enforce Canonical 3-Column Standard: Col 1 ('ردیف'), Col 2 ('متغیر'), Col 3 ('مؤلفه')
important_decisions.rationale: Directly resolves user feedback by separating the sequential numeric identifier ('ردیف'), the psychological parent construct ('متغیر'), and the specific dimension/subscale ('مؤلفه'). Completely eliminates visual conflation and parsing ambiguity.

alternatives_considered.option: Retain 2 columns with hyphen/em-dash prefix (e.g., '— اضطراب آینده‌نگر')
alternatives_considered.reason: Explicitly rejected by user critique; fails to establish clear tabular relational boundaries.

alternatives_considered.option: 2 columns without row number: Col 1 ('متغیر') and Col 2 ('مؤلفه')
alternatives_considered.reason: Violates user instruction '1. raw number, 2. variable, and 3. subscale' and standard Iranian dissertation formatting.

important_decisions.selected_option: Expand Table 15 in compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py from 11 columns to 13 columns
important_decisions.rationale: Decouples embedded row indices ('۱. اضطراب آینده‌نگر') into Column 0 ('ردیف': '۱'), Column 1 ('متغیر': 'تحمل‌ناپذیری عدم‌قطعیت'), and Column 2 ('مؤلفه': 'اضطراب آینده‌نگر'), followed by correlation columns '۱' through '۱۰'.

alternatives_considered.option: Leave correlation matrix with embedded row numbers and only update Table 4-13
alternatives_considered.reason: Inconsistent cross-chapter standard; Table 15 is explicitly highlighted in user critique.
